notFound.title: Submission not found
notFound.description: This submission does not exist, has been deleted, or falls outside your administration scope.

header.progressNoTarget: {count} review submitted | {count} review submitted | {count} reviews submitted
header.readBy: Read by one committee member | Read by one committee member | Read by {count} committee members
header.firstVisit: You are opening this submission for the first time.

decision.title: Decision
decision.hint: Restricted to those entitled to it. Scoring, on the other hand, is open to any assigned committee member.
decision.none: No decision is available from the current state of this submission.
decision.forbidden: You are not entitled to decide on this edition.

confirm.title: {action} — {reference}
confirm.description: The submission moves from “{from}” to “{to}”. The lead organization is notified.
confirm.reasonHint: Required for this transition: it is kept in the submission history and sent to the organization.
confirm.reasonOptionalHint: Optional. If filled in, it is kept in the history and sent to the organization.

decision.notAllowed: This transition is not available from the current state of the submission.
decision.error: The decision could not be saved. Nothing was changed.

dossier.sessionsRequested: One occurrence requested | One occurrence requested | {count} occurrences requested

record.title: Participation record
record.editions: across one edition | across one edition | across {count} editions
record.sessions: No activity held | One activity held | {count} activities held
record.firstTime: First proposal from this organization to IFDD.

speakers.title: Speakers
speakers.empty: No speaker is announced in this submission.
speakers.invited: Invitation sent on {date}, no answer yet

documents.title: Documents
documents.empty: No file is attached to this submission.
documents.quarantined: File quarantined by the antivirus scan: it cannot be opened.

panel.title: My review
panel.description: Your scores are visible to no one until you submit them.

notAssigned.title: This submission is not assigned to you
notAssigned.description: You may read it and write to the committee, but the grid is reserved for the members in charge of it.

cannotReview.title: Read only
cannotReview.description: You are not entitled to score proposals for this edition.

panel.knockoutHint: A score of zero on this criterion disqualifies the submission, whatever the average.
panel.knockoutWarning: Knockout score given on: {criteria}. As it stands, your review disqualifies this submission whatever the average.
panel.missing: One criterion still to score | One criterion still to score | {count} criteria still to score
panel.weaknessesPlaceholder: What is missing, what is worrying…
panel.privateNoteHint: Visible to you only. It is sent neither to the committee nor to the applicant.
panel.submitHint: Submitting makes your review visible to the committee and lifts blind review for you.
panel.submitBlocked: Score every criterion before submitting your review.
panel.error: Your review could not be saved. Nothing was lost: try again.

recusal.title: Declare a connection and recuse yourself
recusal.description: You declare a connection with one of the organizations behind this submission and withdraw from its evaluation. The declaration is kept: it is what attests to the committee's impartiality.
recusal.reasonHint: Required. One sentence is enough: membership, ongoing collaboration, personal interest.
recusal.reasonRequired: State the nature of the connection before recusing yourself.
recusal.success: You have recused yourself from this submission. The committee is informed.
recusal.done: You recused yourself from this submission on {date}.
recusal.error: The recusal could not be saved.

peers.title: Committee reviews
peers.empty: No other review has been submitted yet.

blind.title: Blind review
blind.description: This call runs blind: you will see your peers' scores as soon as you submit yours. This prevents the first score from setting the tone for the others.
blind.count: No review submitted yet | One review has already been submitted | {count} reviews have already been submitted

committee.title: Committee
committee.missing: One review is still missing | One review is still missing | {count} reviews are still missing
committee.complete: Every expected review has been submitted.
committee.empty: No committee member is assigned to this submission.

comments.title: Discussion
comments.description: Two threads on one submission: what the committee writes to itself, and what is addressed to the organization.

committee.label: Internal to the committee
committee.hint: Read by committee members and the IFDD team. The organization does not see it.

submitter.label: Shared with the applicant
submitter.hint: Sent to the lead organization, which is notified. A message that has been read cannot be taken back.

private.label: Personal note
private.hint: Visible to you only, including from other committee members.

compose.label: Write a message
compose.changeRequest: Request a correction from the applicant
compose.changeRequestHint: The submission stays flagged “correction expected” until this point is resolved. A change request is always shared with the organization.
compose.empty: Write a message before sending it.

confirm.title: This message goes to the organization
confirm.description: It will be read by {organization}, which will be notified by email. A message that has been sent cannot be taken back.
confirm.checkbox: I have checked who receives this message.

comments.error: The message could not be sent.
